motivation: G3.6 exposes a one-bit ceiling for one-shot binary interventions. G3.7 makes observation sequential, response-adaptive and explicitly DIN-like.

policy.intervention: continuous binary hyperplane synthesized at each step
policy.cost: one unit per intervention plus declared complexity penalty
policy.din_reentry: posterior/model-fiber closure after each response changes the next intervention

primary_endpoints: expected residual target entropy at matched total cost
expected intervention cost to exact claim closure
probability of exact claim closure by horizon
policy regret versus exact dynamic programming
